title: Collectables - Brain in a Jar Guide
subtitle: How the A Matter of Matter collectable quest works in Skyline Valley, where all 150 Brains in Jars are, and every reward for collecting them.

sections.title: How A Matter of Matter Works
sections.html:
Touching a mysterious glass container holding a brain starts the A Matter of Matter questline, which asks what the brains are for. There are 150 Brains in Jars to find: 148 in Skyline Valley, 2 in Savage Divide.

Collected brains are handed in at the Organic Consciousness Collection Terminal. Lifetime challenges track how many you have found and pay out at set milestones, listed below.

sections.title: Brain in a Jar Locations
sections.html:
The brains are split into pages of 30, in route order.

  • Brain in a Jar Locations 1 - 30
  • Brain in a Jar Locations 31 - 60
  • Brain in a Jar Locations 61 - 90
  • Brain in a Jar Locations 91 - 120
  • Brain in a Jar Locations 121 - 150

Maps

  • Savage Divide map
  • Skyline Valley map
  • Full 4K map

sections.title: FAQ and Important Info
sections.html:
The A Matter of Matter quest reward is a base of 1,200 caps, plus XP and a Skyline Valley loot roll.

The locations are numbered in route order, starting at Marshal Canton's Trading Post. Work through the pages in order and the route flows from one brain to the next.
